remarks: WELCOME TO REGENCY TOWERS..... This exceptionally spacious two-bedroom, two full bath corner unit is sunny and bright, and the placement of the bedrooms offers maximum privacy. The apartment is in wonderful condition. Great closet space in both bedrooms plus additional storage in the large foyer closet. This location places you within easy access to all downtown Stamford has to offer including wonderful restaurants, houses of worship, shopping, library, train, theatres and Mill River Park. A short drive will take you to all Stamford beaches. The building has 24-hour doorman service and a designated parking space #5 in the underground garage. HOA INCLUDES HEAT, HOT WATER AND COOKING GAS. You'll enjoy fabulous sunsets while relaxing on the west facing screened balcony ...current tenant is packing, photos were taken before she moved in.
